templeInformation.travelNote: This kshethram is located 10 km from Madurai.

sthalaPuranam:
The legend has it that Lord Vishnu, in the form of Mohini Avataram, distributed the celestial nectar Amritam to the Devas; hence, this place is also called Mohana-kshethram. It is also believed that Pulastya Muni performed tapas at this kshethram to have children. This Lord is believed to guide souls who have left the blazing body in the venture of Vaikuntham. The Lord is said to throw water like a Megham (cloud) every step of the way so that the road to Vaikuntham is cool.

ChakrathAzhwar

The worship of ChakrathAzhwar at this kshethram is very important, as He is believed to remove any hurdles in one’s life or on the journey to Vaikuntham. Devotees who come to this kshethram without fail take home with them a yanthram, which consists of the imagery of the Lord along with the Sudharshana Mantram engraved onto a copper or brass plate.
azhwarPasuram:
Nam Azhwar: 11 Pasurams
Tiruumangai Azhwar: 1 pasuram
Total: 12 Pasurams
